	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_windmills_02
				has_building = windmills_02
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 1 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 2 HEALTH = 0 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_windmills_01
				has_building = windmills_01
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 1 HEALTH = 0 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = 0 }
	}
	# aawc_workshops: Stage 3 workshop infrastructure
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_08
				has_building = workshops_08
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 12 HEALTH = -3 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 1 SPACE_PERCENT = -4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_07
				has_building = workshops_07
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 10 HEALTH = -3 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 1 SPACE_PERCENT = -3.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_06
				has_building = workshops_06
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 9 HEALTH = -2 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 1 SPACE_PERCENT = -3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_05
				has_building = workshops_05
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 7 HEALTH = -2 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 1 SPACE_PERCENT = -2.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_04
				has_building = workshops_04
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 6 HEALTH = -1 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = -2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_03
				has_building = workshops_03
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 4 HEALTH = -1 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = -1.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_02
				has_building = workshops_02
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 3 HEALTH = -1 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_building = aawc_workshops_01
				has_building = workshops_01
			}
		}
		aawc_stage2_add_contribution_effect = { SUSTENANCE = 0 HABITATION = 0 OPPORTUNITY = 1 HEALTH = 0 SECURITY = 0 AMENITIES = 0 SPACE_PERCENT = -0.5 }
	}
}
